items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Doc Pomus brought me to his house, and I had dinner with him.

ctx.x: This is Doc Pomus, the great blues composer and singer.
Right, and writer. Anyway, Doc used to come to the Baby Grand.

items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Doc Pomus brought me to his house, and I had dinner with him.

ctx.x: Oh boy. He didn’t like it, because . . .
. . . yeah. He didn’t like it, because Doc Pomus brought me to his house, and I had dinner with him. He didn’t like it. Very nasty.
